title: na bhool kar bhi kabhi tum kisi ki baat karo
body:
NA BHOOL KAR BHI KABHI TUM KISI KI BAAT KARO…
ALI KA ZIKR KARO BAS ALI KI BAAT KARO….
<<DIVIDER>>
KISI KA NAFS KISI KA WASI KISI KA Kafi,
YE SAB SIFAAT HO JIS ME USI KI BAAT KARO….
<<DIVIDER>>
hai waqt naz'aa ka baali pe aaye hai maula
kaha'n ki maut bas ab zindagi ki baat karo
<<DIVIDER>>
farishto'n kaisa sawaal o jawaab turbat me
ab aa gaye ho to baitho ali ki baat karo
<<DIVIDER>>
SAMAJH ME AANA SAKE GA KABHI ALI KA MAQAAM,
NA IS TARAH KABHI DEEWANGI KI BAAT KARO….
<<DIVIDER>>
WOH BAAT EK HAI KUCH FARQ HI NAHIN PADTA,
KHUDA KI BAAT KARO YA ALI KI BAAT KARO…..
<<DIVIDER>>
LEHED ME MERI ANDHERA HO GHAIR MUMKIN HAI,
JAHAN ALI HO WAHAN ROSHNI KI BAAT KARO
<<DIVIDER>>
BAWAQTE NAZ'AA KAHUNGA RASHEED SE MAI SAYEED
NIKAL RAHA HAI MERA DAM ALI KI BAAT KARO
